description: Write the main feature specification document (docs/occm_groups_spec.md) for the OCCM Groups feature, covering all aspects of the design grounded in actual Mastodon codebase conventions.
steps: Create docs/occm_groups_spec.md with a comprehensive specification organized into the following sections:
1. Overview and Goals: Describe the groups feature purpose, non-federation requirement, and compatibility goals with PR #19059

2. Database Schema: Design tables with occm_ prefix (occm_groups, occm_group_memberships, occm_group_reports, occm_group_statuses, occm_group_dm_rooms placeholder). Reference the pattern from list.rb (bigint primary keys, timestamps, belongs_to account). Include schema annotations matching Mastodon's == Schema Information style.

3. API Endpoints: Design REST endpoints under /api/v1/occm_groups/ following the pattern in lists_controller.rb and lists/accounts_controller.rb. Include: CRUD for groups, membership management (join/approve/reject/remove), group timeline, post to group, admin transfer, moderator management, group reports, post deletion.
4. OAuth Scopes: Define read:occm_groups, write:occm_groups scopes following the pattern in config/initializers/doorkeeper.rb

5. Permissions and Roles: Detail the admin/moderator/user role system. Admin is creator, cannot leave (must delete or transfer). Admin appoints moderators. Document each action and which roles can perform it.

6. Notification Types: Define occm_group_join_request, occm_group_join_approved, occm_group_join_rejected, occm_group_post_deleted notification types following the pattern in notification.rb PROPERTIES hash
7. Group Report System: Design internal reporting that goes to group admin/moderators (not server admins). Reference the Report model pattern. Include future 'group rules' extensibility.
8. Group DM Room Considerations: Schema-level placeholder design for future group DM rooms (occm_group_dm_rooms table stub)

9. UI/UX Flow: Describe all screens referencing existing Mastodon List UI patterns (features/lists/index.tsx for group list, features/lists/new.tsx for group creation form, features/lists/members.tsx for member management, features/list_timeline/index.jsx for group timeline). Describe compose UI changes for 'post to group' mode.
10. i18n Requirements: Specify that all strings need en and ko translations. Show sample translation keys following config/locales/en.yml and ko.yml patterns.
11. Non-Federation Design: Explain how group posts are local-only (not federated), posts/mentions restricted to group members. Reference the status visibility concern pattern.
12. Streaming: Design group timeline streaming channel following the connectListStream pattern in actions/streaming.js
13. Frontend Architecture: Describe Redux state shape, API type definitions, actions, and reducers following the lists pattern (reducers/lists.ts, api/lists.ts, api_types/lists.ts, actions/lists.js)
acceptance_criteria: docs/occm_groups_spec.md exists and is well-structured markdown
All database tables use occm_ prefix to avoid PR #19059 conflicts
OAuth scopes use occm_ naming to avoid conflicts
Each section references actual Mastodon file paths and patterns found in the codebase
Notification types are defined with the PROPERTIES hash format matching notification.rb
UI/UX descriptions reference specific existing Mastodon components and features
Group admin cannot leave constraint is specified
Group posts are specified as non-federated/local-only
Report system routes to group admin/moderators, not server admins
i18n section includes both en and ko sample keys
Schema includes placeholder for future group DM rooms
